title: The Shawshank Redemption
tagline: Two decades inside. One cold beer on the roof.
about: A banker wrongly jailed for murder spends two decades in Shawshank, quietly keeping hope alive.
cue: Pour the beers when the tarring crew gets their cold ones on the roof.
faces: Pour the beers when the tarring crew gets their cold ones on the roof.
Tonight I found us cold beers and a proper dinner. Forty years inside teaches you to eat a good meal slowly.
Beef chuck, potatoes and carrots slow-cooked in rich stock
the warm Pacific town Andy dreams about
Buttermilk cornbread baked in a hot pan
Chunky avocado with lime, red onion, jalapeño and coriander
Milk chocolate with marshmallows, peanuts and broken biscuits
Cold lager topped with ginger beer, fresh ginger and lime
No seconds. No exceptions. Prices subject to change. Form CF-19. 1994.

batter50g butter, to serveHeat a greased 25cm pan in the oven at 210°C.Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt with the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter.Pour into the hot pan and bake.Cut into squares and serve with butter.Zihuatanejo guacamoleChunky avocado with lime, red onion, jalapeño and corianderHow to make it3 ripe avocados2 limes1/2 red onion1 jalapeno1 handful coriander230g corn chipssalt, to tasteMash the avocados roughly with lime juice and salt.Stir in the finely diced red onion, jalapeno and chopped coriander.Serve straight away with warm corn chips.MainsBrooks's library beef stewBeef chuck, potatoes and carrots slow-cooked in rich stockHow to make it1kg beef chuck, diced2 tbsp vegetable oil2 onions2 tbsp plain flour750ml beef stock600g potatoes3 carrots8 slices of white breadChop the onions, potatoes and carrots.Brown the beef in the vegetable oil in batches.Soften the onions, return the beef with the flour, stock, potatoes and carrots.Cover and simmer until tender.Ladle into bowls with thick white bread.Zihuatanejo grilled fish tacosThe warm Pacific town Andy dreams aboutHow to make itAs written, serves 4White fish rubbed with chilli, cumin and lime, chargrilled and flaked into warm corn tortillas with cabbage, pineapple salsa and lime crema.Rub 600g firm white fish fillets with 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, oil, salt and lime zest.Dice 200g pineapple with half a red onion, 1 chopped chilli, coriander and lime juice.Shred a quarter of a cabbage.Mix 150g sour cream with the juice of 1 lime.Grill the fish on a hot oiled plate for 3 minutes a side and flake.Warm 12 small corn tortillas and fill with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.SweetsRock hammer rocky roadMilk chocolate with marshmallows, peanuts and broken biscuitsHow to until set, which is the setting time.Cut into rough rocks.DrinksRooftop ginger beer shandyCold lager topped with ginger beer, fresh ginger and limeHow to make it4 bottles of lager (375 ml each), cold600ml ginger beer1 knob ginger (3cm)2 limesPut 4 glasses in the freezer to chill.Slice the ginger into thin coins and cut the limes into wedges.Pour lager into each glass, top with ginger beer, squeeze in a lime wedge and add 2 ginger coins. For anyone not drinking, use all ginger beer with extra lime.
